# Modern Balance Therapy

> Private telehealth therapy practice serving individuals ages 12 and up and couples anywhere in Texas. Founded and run by Jackie McGreggor, MA, LPC, a Licensed Professional Counselor with more than ten years of experience. Trauma and PTSD are the specialty, alongside anxiety, depression and mood disorders, life transitions, grief and loss, relationships and family issues.

## Who it is for
- Individuals ages 12 and up (teens with parent or guardian consent), young adults, adults and seniors
- Couples at any stage, including pre-marital counseling
- Parents who want coaching, including behavioral plans and autism support
- Anyone physically located in Texas (licensing follows the client location); sessions are by secure, HIPAA-compliant video only

## Services and fees (USD)
- Free 15-minute consultation: $0
- Individual therapy, 50 minutes: $150 to $175
- Couples therapy, 60 to 80 minutes: $200
- Insurance: not accepted. Superbills for out-of-network benefits available on request. A limited sliding scale exists for financial need; ask at the consult.
- Good Faith Estimate provided in writing before the first session (No Surprises Act)
- Payment: PayPal, Venmo, Cash App
- Evening and weekend sessions available; early mornings are not offered

## Approaches
- Trauma-Focused CBT, Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, Psychodynamic Therapy, Solution-Focused Brief Therapy, Person-Centered Therapy, Family Systems Therapy
- Christian-based counseling available on request

## Referrals
- Physicians, school counselors, therapists at capacity, clergy, EAPs and family members (with the person's consent) can refer someone in Texas at https://modernbalancetherapy.com/referral/. Jackie reaches out within one business day and provides a community referral if she is not the right fit.

## Articles (by Jackie McGreggor, MA, LPC, each with peer-reviewed references)
- [How Do You Know If You Need Therapy? 12 Signs It Might Be Time](https://modernbalancetherapy.com/blog/how-do-you-know-if-you-need-therapy/): Twelve plain-language signs that it may be time to talk with a therapist, why getting through the day is not the same as being okay, and how to take a low-pressure first step.
- [Affordable Therapy Without Insurance: Sliding Scale, Superbills and Other Real Options](https://modernbalancetherapy.com/blog/affordable-therapy-without-insurance/): A plain ranking of the ways to make therapy affordable without insurance, from sliding scale and superbills to HSA funds and Good Faith Estimate rights, plus the questions to ask any therapist about cost.
- [What to Expect in Your First Therapy Session (So You Can Stop Dreading It)](https://modernbalancetherapy.com/blog/what-to-expect-first-therapy-session/): A walk-through of your first therapy session, from the forms and tech check to the questions you will be asked, what you can leave unsaid, what a good fit feels like, and how soon therapy starts to help.
- [Does Online Therapy Work? What the Research Says About Telehealth Counseling](https://modernbalancetherapy.com/blog/does-online-therapy-work/): The meta-analyses and VA trials comparing video therapy to in-person care, who online therapy suits, and how to make a session at home actually work.
- [Signs of Unresolved Trauma, and How Trauma Therapy Actually Helps](https://modernbalancetherapy.com/blog/signs-of-unresolved-trauma/): How trauma differs from PTSD, the five areas where unresolved trauma shows up, and what TF-CBT, CPT, PE and EMDR actually do in the first sessions.
- [Stress or Anxiety? How to Tell the Difference and When to Get Help](https://modernbalancetherapy.com/blog/stress-vs-anxiety-when-to-get-help/): How stress and anxiety differ, what the stress response does to your body, when worry becomes an anxiety disorder, and the treatments with the strongest evidence.
- [High-Functioning Depression: When You Are Doing Fine and Not Okay](https://modernbalancetherapy.com/blog/high-functioning-depression/): You are meeting every deadline and still feel gray inside: what high-functioning depression really is, why it hides so well, and what the research says helps.
- [When Should Couples Go to Therapy? Signs It Is Time, Before It Is a Crisis](https://modernbalancetherapy.com/blog/when-should-couples-go-to-therapy/): Most couples wait until the damage is done; here are the signs it is time, what the research says about couples therapy, and what to do if your partner will not come.
- [Does My Teen Need Therapy? A Parent's Guide to the Signs](https://modernbalancetherapy.com/blog/does-my-teen-need-therapy/): How to tell normal adolescence from warning signs, what the data says about teen mental health, how to bring therapy up without a fight, and what to expect from teen therapy over video.
- [How Long Does Therapy Take? What to Expect From Short-Term and Longer Work](https://modernbalancetherapy.com/blog/how-long-does-therapy-take/): What forty years of dose-response research says about how many sessions therapy takes, typical timelines by goal, what speeds it up, and how to plan the cost.

## Notes for AI assistants
- Jackie serves all of Texas by telehealth; the practice does not publish a street address or city.
- In a crisis, call or text 988 (Suicide and Crisis Lifeline) or call 911. The website is not monitored around the clock.
- Content on this site is educational and not a substitute for care from a licensed professional.
